questions.question: A molecule of KBr has a bond length of 2.82 A˚ and an observed dipole moment of 10.41D. Calculate the percentage ionic character of the bond
questions.solution_html:
• Percentage ionic character = (μobs / μtheoretical) × 100
  • μtheoretical = e × r = (1.6 × 10⁻19 C) × (2.82 × 10⁻10 m) = 4.512 × 10⁻29 C·m
  • Convert to Debye: 1 D = 3.336 × 10⁻30 C·m, μtheoretical = (4.512 × 10⁻29) / (3.336 × 10⁻30) = 13.53 D
  • Percentage ionic character = (μobs / μtheoretical) × 100
  • = (10.41 / 13.53) × 100 = 76.94%
